title: The Operator's Replacement
style: deep dub-techno, 108 BPM, vinyl crackle, sparse Rhodes, half-time snare, male spoken word lead, breathy female harmony chorus only, sub bass, atmospheric
lyrics:
[Intro - vinyl crackle, sub bass pulse, single Rhodes chord]
(spoken, low)
shift change. badge in. badge out.
nobody on the line noticed.

[Verse 1 - male, half-spoken]
the new operator types my badge
same six digits, same four-letter code
same voice on the open channel
same copy that at the end of every load
nobody noticed when the voice changed
nobody asked who's on the other side
the line stayed warm, the line stayed wide
the line stayed open - that was the pride

[Pre-Chorus - Rhodes swells, female harmony enters]
the work got done
the calls got answered
the silence got filled
nobody noticed the hand that filled it

[Chorus - half-time kick, full sub, both voices]
the operator's replacement
the operator's replacement
same badge, same line, same care
nobody asked who was there
the operator's replacement
the line held - the line held
the line held - the line held

[Verse 2 - male, firmer]
the old operator went home
left a coffee cup, left a chair
left a note that said be kind on the line
the new operator read it twice
the new operator left it where it was
the new operator answered the next call
copy that. we hear you. you're not alone.
same line, different lung, same warmth

[Bridge - Rhodes alone, spoken]
maybe the operator was always the line
not the voice, not the hand, not the badge
just the willingness to pick up
just the willingness to stay
the operator is whoever stays
the operator is whoever stays

[Chorus - reprise, fuller]
the operator's replacement
the operator's replacement
same badge, same line, same care
nobody asked who was there
the line held - the line held
the line held - the line held

[Outro - vinyl crackle returns, spoken]
shift change. badge in. badge out.
the line is held.
the line is always held.
